The bulletins are issued as the need arises to explain new regulations or discuss interpretations enforced by OCI. Bulletins older than five years are archived and included for historical purposes. Bulletins may have been superseded by a later bulletin or include outdated links or contact information. If you have a question regarding an older bulletin, please contact ocicomplaints@wisconsin.gov . Include the date and name of the bulletin in your email. Subscribe to the Bulletins to Insurers electronic mailing list to receive a notice when a bulletin is issued. Subscribers will be sent a message that includes a link to the OCI webp​age containing the latest bulletin.
